payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is a frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
node.criteria: For R1, complete if s1 passes. Absent if s1 fails and there is no visible evidence of partial progress toward placing a frog inside the toilet. Partial if the image shows some progress toward placing a frog inside but does not clearly show a frog within the bowl. Unknown if required evidence is insufficient or unresolved; do not infer completion or absence from uncertainty. Unrelated edits are not progress.
